LESSON: READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NON- FICTION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: what he or she has read about. 1. What is the importance of reading widely?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify print and non- print non-fiction materials that are interesting to read
2. read a range of non- fiction materials for general information
3. appreciate the importance of reading for information

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NON- FICTION
This lesson teaches Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify print and non- print non-fiction materials that are interesting to read
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. read a range of non- fiction materials for general information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of reading for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction above.
2. Explain Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what he or she has read about. 1. What is the importance of reading widely?
2. What do you consider when selecting a reading text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify print and non- print non-fiction materials that are interesting to read
2. read a range of non- fiction materials for general information
3. appreciate the importance of reading for information
